purpose: Transparent legal-knowledge coverage registry. A catalogue entry is not an indexed legal text or a legal conclusion.
indexing_rule: Only official material downloaded, metadata-audited, versioned and marked current may be retrieved as a citation.

state_and_ut_law.status: 36 jurisdictions catalogued; individual official connectors and audited documents still required

government_schemes.status: official discovery catalogue configured; scheme-level eligibility must be fetched and date-verified before retrieval

case_law.status: official discovery catalogue configured; judgments must be individually acquired, parsed, cited and updated before retrieval

non_claim: This project does not claim to contain all Indian laws, schemes, notifications, court cases, or state rules. These collections change frequently and must be kept jurisdiction- and date-specific.
